question: Does the platform accept every English keyword of the bilingual table, and does the Designer emit the Russian canonical text?
text:
SELECT ALLOWED DISTINCT TOP 10
	V.Code AS Code,
	CASE WHEN V.Code LIKE "1%" ESCAPE "~" THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS F1,
	ISNULL(V.Description, "") AS F2,
	SUBSTRING(V.Description, 1, 2) AS F3,
	CAST(V.Code AS STRING(10)) AS F4,
	VALUETYPE(V.Ref) AS F5,
	PRESENTATION(V.Ref) AS F6
INTO TT
FROM
	Catalog.Валюты AS V
		LEFT JOIN Catalog.Валюты AS W
		ON V.Ref = W.Ref
WHERE
	V.Ref IN HIERARCHY (&List)
	AND NOT V.DeletionMark
	AND V.Code BETWEEN "0" AND "9"
	AND V.Ref REFS Catalog.Валюты
	AND W.Ref IS NOT NULL
INDEX BY
	Code
;
SELECT
	T.Code AS Code,
	COUNT(*) AS N
FROM
	TT AS T
GROUP BY
	T.Code
HAVING
	COUNT(*) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT
	"",
	0
ORDER BY
	Code DESC
AUTOORDER
TOTALS
	SUM(N)
BY
	OVERALL
;
DROP TT
metadataNeeds: Any catalog (English type name Catalog with a Russian object name).
record: Record platform build, acceptance and the Query Designer canonical text.
